morphology_rules: Forehead cranial ridges are the primary recurring species-readable feature in the supplied late-24th-century-style references.
Ridge topology varies strongly between individuals and must not be standardized to one pattern.
Cranial ridges can change forehead height, brow silhouette and upper-face contour.
Humanlike variation in skin tone, facial proportions, hair and facial hair remains broad.
Male- and female-presenting individuals both retain strong individual cranial-ridge identity.
identity_rules: Forehead-ridge topology is part of persistent visual identity.
Age, scars, hair, rank, clothing and expression may change without replacing ridge/face identity.
Era-aware morphology must resolve before final production because screen presentation changes across periods.
cultural_separation: Do not add armor, weapons, House symbols or warrior styling from species alone.
Do not encode honor or aggression as a neutral facial expression.
forbidden: one famous Klingon ridge pattern reused across procedural NPCs
House insignia without actual House state
